sources: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Leelanau State Park campsites via /api/maps, /api/resourcelocation/resources and /api/resource/feeDetails for 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13; audit/state_park_fees/gtc_probe.py, read 2026-10-25)

values.note: $20 a night for every rustic campsite (booking site, 2027-05-18 and 07-13 alike; the 2026 DNR rates table also lists $20). A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park campgrounds.

fees.source: https://midnrreservations.com/ (Leelanau State Park: fee schedule -32490, 51 campsites, feeTotal $20 for 2027-05-18 and 2027-07-13) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Leelanau campground: Rustic camping rate $20) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/leelanau ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/leelanau (Leelanau Rustic Campground: 'There are no electricity, modern restrooms, showers or dump station available.') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (all 51 campsites 'Electrical Service=Not Available', 'Sewer Hookup=No'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 51 rustic campsites, about half right on the water. Small sites: on the booking site 22 take trailers/RVs of 25 ft or more (12 to 25 ft, 5 to 30, 4 to 35, site 1 to 40), 12 only to 20 ft, and the rest are tent-only. One pull-through. Two vehicles per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/leelanau ('Number of sites: 51'; 'About half of the campsites are located right on the water') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (each of the 51 campsites' allowed equipment, 'Trailer or RV up to 20'' ... 40''; 'Pull Through=Yes' on one site; 'Vehicles Per Site=2'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water and a place to fill trailers with potable water, but no dump station. Lighthouse gift shop sells some camping supplies.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/leelanau (Leelanau Rustic Campground: 'There is access to drinking water and a place to fill trailers with potable water. There are no electricity, modern restrooms, showers or dump station available.'; tags 'Vault toilet', 'Concession or store'; 'The Lighthouse Gift Shop sells ... some camping supplies') + DNR rates table (Leelanau campground: 'Rustic - No modern restrooms'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve online on MiDNRReservations or at 800-447-2757.

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/leelanau (Leelanau Rustic Campground: 'For reservations call 800-447-2757 or reserve online') + https://midnrreservations.com/ (51 bookable campsites) + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Leelanau campground: reservation season starts May 1, ends November 5), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic campground at the very tip of the Leelanau Peninsula beside the Grand Traverse Lighthouse (15310 N. Lighthouse Point Rd, Northport): rocky beach and big trees, about half the sites right on Lake Michigan and the rest tucked into the woods with lake views. Known for small sites: choose one the booking site rates for your rig. Three mini cabins in the campground; the park's Cathead Bay trails and sandy beach are on a separate unit 4 mi south. --Claude
summary: DNR park page + booking site + DNR rates table: $20 (confirmed, 2027 booking site), 51 sites (confirmed), pull-through (one site, confirmed), max 40 ft (new; most sites 20-30 ft, ~17 tent-only), no electric (confirmed; water/sewer false new), vault toilets + potable water + trailer fill, no showers/dump/flush (confirmed/new), reservable on MiDNRReservations (confirmed), reservation season May 1 - Nov 5 (new, booking.season). Season left as stored (year_round false, derived): no page states the campground's operating dates. Phone 231-386-5422 matches. Note: dropped field restatements and 'Lake Michigan/Cathead Bay' (Cathead Bay is the park's separate southern unit).
